page.layout: One column of running text at the top, with the date line below it. Then the heading "EPIST. LXII." and an italic-and-roman letter summary in a centred block at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.p: collegiorum regimen abreptum ad ejus-modi studium repente animum appulis-se.

Propositionum à Sorbonicis nota-tarum pauca exemplaria cudi curarunt, sed sine Sorbonicis notis, quarum exemplar ad Eminentiam vestram mitto, ut & alias manu scriptas, quæ post Sorbonicam Censuram à nonnullis Sorbonicis ex R. P. Celloti libris excerptæ sunt, quarum exemplar quod in manus meas incidere contigit, similiter mitto, ut Eminentia vestra, quid de his pronunciandum sit, decernat; fere enim omnibus male audit hic liber; meritò an immeritò, propositionibus illis in ipso autoris textu consideratis dicernat hanc litem Eminentia Vestra, quam salvam & incolumem Ecclesiæ suæ Deus quam diutissimè conservet.
main_text.head: EPIST. LXII.
Cardinalis Barberinus Johanni Morino: De Abrahami Ecchellensis Bibliis Syriacis, Deinde Jaudat[?] propositum de scri-

page.notes: The printed mark after "LXII" appears to be an asterisk or ornament; it is not transcribed. "Jaudat" is uncertain: the initial glyph may be L or J. "dicernat" and "Ecclesiæ" are kept as printed. Line-end hyphens in "ejus-", "appulis-", "nota-", "exem-", "Sorbo-", "Emi-", "pronuncian-", "imme-", "in-", "diu-" and "scri-" are retained. The page ends mid-word at "scri-", which continues on the next page.
